Dear Sir/Maam,

We wish to inform pursuant to 33 Reg of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 the BOD at its BM held today i.e Tuesday, 11th August, 2026 has approved the Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone) for the Quarter ended 30th June, 2026. Enclosed herewith Financials and LRR for Quarter ended 30th June, 2026.

Kindly take the same on records.
NEWSSUB: Outcome Of Board Meeting Held Today I.E. On Tuesday, 11Th August, 2026.
